rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: It is an expectation that all patients receive care/services from a licensed clinician. All appropriate supporting documentation, including recent pertinent office visit notes, laboratory data, and results of any special testing must be provided. If applicable: All prior relevant imaging results and the reason that alternative imaging cannot be performed must be included in the documentation submitted.
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: Advanced Diagnostic Imaging (CT, MRI, PET, Nuclear Medicine)

criteria.description: Care and services ordered or provided by a licensed clinician
Submission of recent pertinent office visit clinical notes
Submission of relevant laboratory data and special testing results

required_documentation: Recent pertinent office visit notes
Laboratory data
Prior relevant imaging reports
Clinical rationale why alternative imaging cannot be performed
rules.review_notes: Universal baseline clinical intake requirement applying across all Evolent imaging guidelines.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: For suspected inflammatory bowel disease after complete work up including physical exam, labs, and recent colonoscopy
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: CT Abdomen and Pelvis (or CT Enterography)

criteria.description: Physical examination documented in medical records
Diagnostic laboratory workup completed
Recent colonoscopy completed prior to advanced imaging request

required_documentation: Physical examination notes
Laboratory results
Recent colonoscopy report
rules.review_notes: Prerequisite workup rule for suspected new onset IBD.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: For evaluation of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) such as Crohn's or Ulcerative Colitis (includes CT enterography, however, MRI should be considered for age < 35 to reduce radiation exposure)
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: CT Abdomen and Pelvis / CT Enterography

criteria.description: Requested procedure is CT enterography or CT abdomen/pelvis for IBD
Patient age is strictly less than 35 years

required_documentation: Documentation of contraindication to MRI (if CT requested for age < 35)
rules.review_notes: Advisory wording ('MRI should be considered'). Flagged for medical director determination regarding whether this constitutes a mandatory denial of CT or peer-to-peer advisory suggestion.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Suspected diverticulitis or acute appendicitis for initial imaging with at least ONE of the following (10): ○ WBC Elevated ○ Fever ○ Anorexia ○ Nausea and vomiting

criteria.description: Suspected acute diverticulitis or acute appendicitis for initial diagnostic evaluation
At least one objective inflammatory or systemic clinical sign present
Elevated white blood cell count (leukocytosis)
Documented fever
Documented anorexia
Documented nausea and vomiting

required_documentation: Clinical notes detailing acute abdominal pain
Vital signs showing temperature/fever or CBC report showing elevated WBC
rules.review_notes: Initial imaging indication with disjunctive clinical symptom checklist.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Suspected appendicitis in a child (< age 18) (12) when ultrasound is inconclusive or cannot be completed (due to body habitus or inability to cooperate) OR when peritoneal signs are present (guarding, rebound) or other red flags

criteria.description: Patient age is strictly less than 18 years
Provisional diagnosis is suspected acute appendicitis
Ultrasound inconclusive/incomplete OR peritoneal signs present
Prior ultrasound inconclusive or incomplete
Peritoneal signs documented (guarding, rebound) or other red flags

required_documentation: Ultrasound report demonstrating inconclusive results or documentation of inability to complete ultrasound
Physical examination notes documenting peritoneal signs (guarding, rebound) if ultrasound was bypassed
rules.review_notes: Pediatric appendicitis radiation sparing protocol mandating ultrasound prior to CT unless peritoneal signs are present.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Initial imaging for suspected acute pancreatitis due to epigastric pain with elevated amylase and/or lipase: ○ Mild presentation when symptom improvement is not seen after 72 hours of treatment and either: ■ Ultrasound has been performed and did not show an abnormality such as gallstones, dilated bile duct ■ Ultrasound suggests complications (such as fluid collection)

criteria.description: Suspected acute pancreatitis with epigastric pain and elevated amylase and/or lipase
Mild presentation without symptom improvement after at least 72 hours of treatment
Prior ultrasound completed showing no gallstones/ductal dilation OR suggesting complications

required_documentation: Serum amylase and lipase laboratory reports
Clinical notes demonstrating persistent symptoms at or beyond 72 hours
Abdominal ultrasound report
rules.review_notes: Temporal constraint requiring 72 hours of conservative care in mild pancreatitis before early CT is medically indicated.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Severe presentation (such as fever, elevated WBC) ○ Decline in clinical status and/or suspected complication

criteria.description: Severe presentation with fever and elevated WBC count
Decline in clinical status or suspected organ complication

required_documentation: Vital signs showing fever
CBC showing leukocytosis
Clinical notes documenting rapid clinical decline or suspected necrosis/phlegmon
rules.review_notes: Severe acute pancreatitis indication bypassing the 72-hour observation window.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Kidney Stone is NOT suspected AND ● Urinalysis is negative for infection or hematuria persists on urine microscopy following treatment of urinary tract infection AND ● At least one of the following: ○ Gross hematuria ○ > 25 RBC/hpf on urine microscopy

criteria.description: Kidney stone is NOT suspected
Urinalysis negative for infection OR hematuria persists following UTI treatment
Gross hematuria OR > 25 RBC/hpf on urine microscopy
Documented gross hematuria
Greater than 25 RBC per high power field on urine microscopy

required_documentation: Urinalysis microscopy report showing RBC count or gross hematuria
Urine culture or documentation showing UTI ruled out or treated
rules.review_notes: High-risk hematuria branch based on American Urological Association (AUA) guidelines.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: 3-25 RBC/hpf on urine microscopy AND ONE or more of the following: ■ >30 pack year smoking history ■ Male ≥ age 60 ■ Abnormal renal ultrasound ■ Negative renal ultrasound and repeat sample shows persistence of ≥ 3 RBC/hpf

criteria.description: 3 to 25 RBC/hpf documented on urine microscopy
At least one established urologic malignancy risk factor present
Greater than 30 pack-year smoking history
Male patient aged 60 or older
Abnormal renal ultrasound finding
Negative renal ultrasound with persistence of >= 3 RBC/hpf on repeat sample

required_documentation: Urine microscopy lab report showing 3-25 RBC/hpf
Clinical notes documenting smoking history, renal ultrasound report, or repeat UA

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: CT Abdomen and Pelvis / CT Angiography Abdomen

criteria.description: Known abdominal aortic aneurysm with maximum diameter between 5.0 and 5.4 cm
At least 6 months elapsed since previous aortic imaging evaluation

required_documentation: Prior imaging report demonstrating AAA size 5.0 - 5.4 cm
Date of last prior aortic imaging study
rules.review_notes: Surveillance frequency rule for pre-surgical threshold aneurysms.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Known or suspected symptomatic AAA (30,31) ○ Symptoms may include: ■ Abrupt onset of severe sharp or stabbing pain in the chest, back or abdomen (could indicate possible aneurysm rupture) ■ Acute abdominal or back pain with a pulsatile or epigastric mass ■ Acute abdominal or back pain and at high risk for aortic aneurysm and/or aortic syndrome (risk factors include hypertension, atherosclerosis, prior cardiac or aortic surgery, underlying aneurysm, connective tissue disorder (Such as Marfan syndrome, vascular form of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, Loeys-Dietz syndrome), and bicuspid aortic valve) (32)
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: CT Angiography / CT Abdomen and Pelvis

criteria.description: Known or clinically suspected symptomatic abdominal aortic aneurysm
Documentation of acute rupture symptoms, pulsatile mass, or high-risk features

required_documentation: Emergency department or urgent clinical evaluation note
Physical examination documenting pain characteristics, pulsatile mass, or hemodynamic instability
rules.review_notes: Urgent indication for suspected rupture or acute expansion.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: When a cancer is not listed above, Abdomen and Pelvis CT is not routinely a part of surveillance for that cancer in an asymptomatic patient. There would need to be a sign or symptom of recurrence to consider Abdomen and Pelvis CT.

criteria.description: Primary cancer diagnosis is not specifically listed in guideline surveillance table
Patient is asymptomatic without signs or symptoms of recurrence

required_documentation: Oncology progress notes demonstrating active signs or symptoms of disease recurrence if CT is requested
exclusion_conditions: Routine routine surveillance CT in asymptomatic patients whose cancer type is not enumerated in guideline table
rules.review_notes: Explicit policy exclusion barring routine unlisted cancer surveillance in asymptomatic individuals.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_section: PREOPERATIVE OR POSTOPERATIVE ASSESSMENT / Postoperative Evaluation
rules.source_quote: Known or suspected complications ● A clinical reason is provided how imaging may change management NOTE: This section applies only within the first few months following surgery

criteria.description: Postoperative evaluation of known or suspected surgical complications
Surgery occurred within the first few months prior to imaging request
Clinical documentation demonstrates how imaging will alter management

required_documentation: Operative report and recent surgical follow-up notes documenting suspected complication
rules.review_notes: Postoperative assessment window applying within first few months following abdominal/pelvic surgery.
